title: Crispy German Pork Schnitzel
description: A classic German dish of thinly sliced pork, breaded and fried to a crispy perfection. This schnitzel recipe is a simple and delicious meal to serve with a side of your favorite vegetables or salad.
instructions: Step 1: In a shallow dish, mix together flour, salt, and pepper.
Step 2: In a separate dish, beat the eggs.
Step 3: In a third dish, place the panko breadcrumbs.
Step 4: Season the pork slices with salt and pepper.
Step 5: Dip each pork slice in the flour mixture, coating both sides, then in the eggs, and finally in the breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Step 6: Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Step 7: Fry the breaded pork slices in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Step 8: Transfer the fried schnitzel to a plate and serve immediately with lemon wedges.
Step 10: Garnish with fresh parsley or dill if desired.
